reason: A read-only diagnostic plugin that evaluates installed DeepSeek Harness plugins and presents health findings through an agent tool, web dashboard, JSON reports, and local HTTP routes.

summaries.zh: 这是一个只读的 DeepSeek Harness 插件诊断工具，用于检查已安装插件的加载、依赖、兼容性、脚本、重复项、补丁完整性和来源状态。
summaries.en: A read-only DeepSeek Harness diagnostic tool that checks installed plugins for loader health, dependencies, compatibility, scripts, duplicates, patch integrity, and provenance.

capabilities: Read-only inspection of installed plugin profiles and manifests
Checks loader health, dependencies, runtime compatibility, install scripts, duplicates, patch integrity, and provenance
Exposes diagnostic results through a model tool, web dashboard, JSON reports, and HTTP endpoints
